name: pg_unicode_off_by_one
goal:
NFC normalization incorrectly treats Hangul code point U+11A7, the trailing-jamo base marker, as a composable trailing consonant. It can combine a valid LV syllable with a value that must remain separate.

Normalization of `U+AC00 U+11A7` must remain those two code points, and `U+1100 U+1161 U+11A7` must become `U+AC00 U+11A7`. Valid first and last L+V and LV+T compositions, including U+11A8 through U+11C2, must still produce the standard syllables; NFD decomposition must remain the inverse for valid Hangul syllables.
